context_notes: Today's session pivoted from autonomous-agent execution to live-test-driven debugging. Three runtime bugs fixed tactically: d8983af (stream:true on Anthropic body — root cause of streamTruncatedFinal), cb7ee6f (mic-regrant phantom rebuild killing wake-word stream within 2s of every cold launch), b92d062 (explicit AVCaptureDevice.requestAccess for mic + camera + honest wizard copy). Then GSD discipline restored for larger work via Phase 10 SPEC. The lesson burned in: 'tests green' != 'production works'. Audit reports passed every prior plan as 'structurally complete' while live launch revealed silent mic, mute TTS, empty Voice Log, DevOverlay zeros, and an LLM claiming it had no audio hardware. Phase 10 SPEC bakes live-launch verification into every plan so this class of regression cannot ship unnoticed.
